description: Log into HospitalRun and generate a Diagnostic Report to analyze disease prevalence. Navigate to the Reports section, select the 'Diagnostic' report type, and configure the date range from January 1, 2025 ('01/01/2025') to January 31, 2025 ('01/31/2025'). Click 'Generate Report' and ensure the results table displays diagnosis data. The system has been pre-loaded with patient data for this period.
